python - <<'PY'
import importlib
import inspect
import os
import sys

import pytest

import control.bdalg as bdalg

TARGETS = {
    ('control.xferfcn', 'feedback'): 'control/xferfcn.py',
    ('control.statesp', 'feedback'): 'control/statesp.py',
    ('control.frdata', 'feedback'): 'control/frdata.py',
    ('control.nlsys', 'feedback'): 'control/nlsys.py',
}

active = 0
hits = set()


def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    global active
    if event == 'call':
        mod = frame.f_globals.get('__name__')
        name = frame.f_code.co_name
        if mod == 'control.bdalg' and name == 'feedback':
            active += 1
        elif active > 0 and (mod, name) in TARGETS:
            hits.add((TARGETS[(mod, name)], f"{mod}.{name}"))
    elif event == 'return':
        mod = frame.f_globals.get('__name__')
        name = frame.f_code.co_name
        if mod == 'control.bdalg' and name == 'feedback' and active > 0:
            active -= 1
    elif event == 'exception':
        mod = frame.f_globals.get('__name__')
        name = frame.f_code.co_name
        if mod == 'control.bdalg' and name == 'feedback' and active > 0:
            # frame still active after exception event; no counter change here
            pass
    return tracer

sys.setprofile(tracer)
try:
    rc = pytest.main([
        '-q',
        'qa_instances_eval/python-control/bdalg_feedback_dispatch_diversity_suite/files/tests/qa/bdalg_feedback_dispatch_diversity_suite_test.py',
    ])
finally:
    sys.setprofile(None)

print('rc', rc)
print('hits', sorted(hits))
